    100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 900, # Century years
    2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024, 2028, 2032, 2036, 2040, 2044, # Regular leap years
    2100, 2200, 2300, 2400, # Century years divisible by 400 (leap) or not divisible by 400 (not leap)
]

all_passed = True
for y in test_cases:
    result = is_leap_year(y)
    status = '✓' if result == (y % 400 == 0 or (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0)) else '✗'
    print(f'{status} is_leap_year({y})={result}')
    if not result == (y % 400 == 0 or (y % 4 == 0 and y % 100 != 0)):
        all_passed = False

print()
if all_passed:
    print('All tests passed!')
else:
    print('Some tests failed!')
